clock: One real second is one game minute; weather pauses during resource loading and is saved.
latte_stack: Multiplicative:110% *80%=88% retrieval/payout speed at full wetness.
shelters: Stores, covered fish stall, cargo page entered from a store, and train travel.
visual: Original 2..6px light rain plus 9..12px middle and 15..21px near streaks; near opacity reaches224/255 with smooth four-hour intensity swells. No new bitmap/particle array/framebuffer.
weight_basis: Game tuning only:blend linearly with rain intensity; retain habitat, bait zeros, size profiles and the conditional1% variant roll. Not real ecology or percentage points.
status_ui: Two18x18 icons with bottom-up wetness fill and remaining-latte fill; no long text bar or large background panel.
region_independence: Same saved absolute clock; separate deterministic map-seeded schedules, including local rain swells. Changing map never transfers rain.
city_clear_mist: Full20:00-06:00; fades06:00-08:00 and18:00-20:00; rain strengthens it. Influence extends downward before docks/actors.
